exam_name: CNML - Certified Nurse Manager and Leader
aliases: CNML - Certified Nurse Manager and Leader

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the CNML - Certified Nurse Manager and Leader exam by reviewing communication, health care environment, leadership, professionalism, and business.
editorial.overview: The CNML - Certified Nurse Manager and Leader certification is administered by the American Organization for Nursing Leadership (AONL). It assesses nurse managers across five core domains including Communication and Relationship Building, Health Care Environment and Clinical Principles, Leadership, Professionalism, and Business Skills and Principles to ensure complete administrative readiness for healthcare leaders.
editorial.who_should_take: Nurse managers and aspiring healthcare leaders seeking official validation of their administrative, clinical leadership, and operational competencies should take this certification exam to demonstrate their professional expertise.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the five domain blueprints provided by the American Organization for Nursing Leadership (AONL) very carefully before test day. Focus your study time proportionally based on the 25.0 percent, 18.0 percent, 25.0 percent, 14.0 percent, and 18.0 percent weights assigned to each respective subject area.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain carefully covers communication strategies, relationship building, and interpersonal dynamics required for nurse leaders to successfully interact with staff, patients, and multidisciplinary healthcare teams within complex organizational structures.

This domain focuses intensely on health care environment settings and core clinical principles relevant to management roles, ensuring that nurse leaders understand patient care delivery systems, safety regulations, and clinical quality standards.

This domain addresses core leadership practices, team direction, and organizational management competencies that empower nurse managers to guide their departments effectively, foster positive work cultures, and navigate complex healthcare operational challenges.

This domain examines professional standards, ethics, and accountability expected of certified nurse leaders, ensuring that candidates adhere to the highest codes of conduct, legal guidelines, and professional nursing values in their daily practice.

This domain covers standard business skills, financial principles, and operational management required in health care organizations, preparing managers to handle budgeting, resource allocation, strategic planning, and cost-effective department administration successfully.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your testing time carefully across the 115 total questions within the 120 minutes allowed to ensure you complete every single item on the assessment successfully.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The certification exam consists of a total of 115 questions spanning all five of the core content domains established by the American Organization for Nursing Leadership.
The passing standard for the assessment is specifically set at 75 scored items in order to demonstrate adequate competency for all certification applicants and candidates.

Candidates taking this healthcare management assessment are given a total duration of 120 minutes to complete the evaluation and successfully answer all required questions within the designated testing time limit without interruption.

The certification program is officially administered, governed, and maintained directly by the American Organization for Nursing Leadership (AONL) for qualified nursing professionals seeking formal career recognition and professional advancement.
